title: Integrals of some compound processes
summary: By means of the theory of compound (non-homogenoeus) Poisson processes we define a general framework which includes most of the generalizations of the Poisson processes, both in the Skellam sense and in the space-fractional sense. We prove that Bernstein subordination is the only time-changing leading to a compound Poisson process. We also consider the case of subordination with inverse Bernstein subordinators.
